description: D28 Amendment 2: a memory-proposal Edit writes the edited text as Save does; a Save with variant merge-downgrade is one replace of the named entry (a plain Save may not replace, a downgraded one may not insert); record with an explicit override note is one insert and drop one declined_add for the item's heading; propose a governance update authorizes nothing. Each near miss (text other than the shown text, another file, another heading, another op type) is refused.
